paper.title: SpatialCLI: Learning to Reason With Spatial Tools, Then Without Them

coverage.notes: Core mechanisms, formulas, main tables, exact tool interfaces, settings, CII, prompts and representative cases are anchored; repeated long case traces and the 63-entry bibliography are retained in the source PDF rather than duplicated verbatim.

claims.claim: Call-Learn-Internalize combines spatial tool use, SFT/RL and trajectory-guided capability internalization.
SpatialCLI-Bench contains 516 compositional examples across grounding, depth and pose capabilities.
Dual-view training improves both tool-free reasoning and tool-use behavior.
